name: Garakuta no Mori no Eden nite
original_name: ガラクタの森のエデンにて
source:
A world that lost 70% of its land because of 'The Collapse'.
Eva, a boy that lost part of his memory from before the world's collapse in a forest of junk in a small island, collecting things that had drifted ashore from other islands that had sunk during 'The Collapse', he passed calm days with a young swordsman Alivio. After one day, Eva regains his past memories with his once best friend 'he'.

This is a story about a boy and a young man living in a heartwarming way in a world after the Collapse, seriously going through memories.

Though it seems to have elements similar to exploration, it is basically a linear novel that you can only read.

[from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21886]Freem![/url]]
translation:
一个因“崩溃”而失去70% 土地的世界。
失去了世界崩溃前部分记忆的少年伊娃，在一座小岛的垃圾林中，收集着“崩溃”期间沉没的其他岛屿漂流到岸上的东西，与年轻的剑客阿利维奥一起度过了平静的日子。一天后，伊娃恢复了与曾经最好的朋友“他”的过去记忆。

这是一个关于在崩坏后的世界里，一个男孩和一个年轻人温馨地生活，认真回忆回忆的故事。

虽然看起来有类似探索的元素，但本质上是一本只能看的线性小说。

[来自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21886]Freem！[/url]]
